newsitem.title: UK: British Steel shares miss out on market rally.
newsitem.headline: British Steel shares miss out on market rally.

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc missed out on the UK equity market's sharp advance on Wednesday, as Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated a "hold" recommendation and highlighted a recent earnings downgrade on the company, dealers said.
In a review of the engineering sector, Kleinwort repeated a recent reduction in its 1997 pre-tax profit estimate to 150 million stg from 200 million, sources said.

The reduction brought Kleinwort in line with other recent-reduced earnings forecasts for British Steel. Merrill Lynch for instance last month cut its current-year pre-tax profit estimate to 140 million stg.

The company's profits have come under pressure because of the strength of sterling, which makes exports less competitive, imports cheaper and which cuts into the sterling value of the profits the company makes abroad.
British Steel shares were unchanged at 150p by 1224 GMT in volume of 1.7 million shares. By contrast the FTSE 100 index was up 40.6 points at 4,648.1.
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.
